claims.citation: New York Herald, 16 May 1866, p. 8, col. 4
claims.verbatim:
Ship Agra (Br), Evans, Cardiff, 38 days, with railroad iron,
to master. Crossed the Banks May 1, in lat 44, and saw no
ice; since which had a succession of westerly gales; had a
pilot on board 5 days.

claims.citation: Lloyd's List, 28 May 1866, p. 3, col. 2 (British Newspaper Archive)
